# Purpose

This template provides the standard structure for all research entries within the Creative OS Research Library.

Research entries preserve information that may inspire future stories, editorial content, Behind the Fire articles, Ghost Story Sunday, Quebec Spotlight, Folklore Friday, and future publishing projects.

# Guiding Principle

Research serves inspiration—not imitation.

Every research entry should support original storytelling while respecting historical accuracy, cultural traditions, and intellectual property.
